quotes.text: Small steps every day lead to big changes.
Fuel your body, don't just feed it.
Your only competition is who you were yesterday.
Strong body, calm mind.
Eat well, move daily, rest deeply.
Discipline turns goals into results.
Progress, not perfection.
Healthy food is an investment, not an expense.
Sweat today, shine tomorrow.
You don't have to be extreme, just consistent.
Your body hears everything your mind says.
Make your plate colorful and your workouts count.
Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
A healthy habit today is a stronger you tomorrow.
Train hard, eat smart, recover well.
The best workout is the one you actually do.
Good nutrition is the foundation of every goal.
Don't wish for it. Work for it.
Every rep brings you closer to your best self.
Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
